description: Preserves local-origin IPC access to every application command for the embedded first-run surface (tauri://localhost, window main). Required because defining the print-bridge app permissions (src-tauri/permissions/print-bridge.toml) registers the app ACL manifest, which turns ACL enforcement on for application commands even from the local origin — before that, app commands were implicitly allowed locally when no app ACL manifest existed. This capability grants no plugin permissions and no remote URLs.
